question:
A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 7 g/cm³. It's internal and external radii are 0 cm and 3 cm respectively. What is the approximte weight (in kg) of the shell? 

Take π=(22)/(7) and Densty=(mass)/(volume)
solution:
**Given:**

Density of the metal = 7 g/cm³

Internal radius (rᵢₙₜₑᵣₙₐₗ) = 0 cm

External radius (rₑₓₜₑᵣₙₐₗ) = 3 cm

Take π = 22/7

Density = Mass / Volume

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a hollow sphere = (4/3)π(rₑₓₜₑᵣₙₐₗ³ - rᵢₙₜₑᵣₙₐₗ³)

Mass = Density × Volume

Weight (in kg) = Mass / 1000
